t: The Forever Machine: Reclaiming Digital Sovereignty with Local AI
s: This article proposes the 'Forever Machine' and 'Chip O'Theseus,' a local, AI-powered system enabling digital sovereignty through immutable infrastructure (Nix), unified Python environments, and persistent local AI memory, challenging cloud dependencies.
sub: Local AI & Digital Sovereignty with the 'Forever Machine'
Nix & Unified Python Runtime for Local Development
Chip O'Theseus: Persistent Local AI with Hybrid Memory & AI Agents
FastHTML/HTMX & WET Architecture for Local Web Apps
